history.board_assessment: In its resolution 73/268 B, the General Assembly did not endorse the recommendation in paragraph 273 of the Board’s report for the period ended 30 June 2018 (A/73/5 (Vol. II), chap. The Board considers both recommendations to have been overtaken by events.
